scale: Scores and changes are on the 0-100 scale.
publication_scope: Reported aggregate values only; no new per-prompt values, video files or human responses.

sgf60_descriptive_adjustment.method: OLS of paired Subject c2c differences on paired Dynamic Degree differences; report intercept. This is descriptive adjustment, not motion-held-fixed intervention.

sf_sink_windows.pooling: Average the two seed-specific differences within each prompt before resampling prompts.
